title: What the Square on Your Toothpaste Really Means

youtube.title: What the Square on Your Toothpaste Really Means
youtube.description:
That colored square on your toothpaste tube isn't an ingredient code. It's an eye mark: on the filling line, a light sensor spots it so the machine knows exactly where to crimp and seal the tube. The color only has to stand out from the tube. The ingredients? They're printed on the box.

Sources:
• Colgate – What is a toothpaste color code: https://www.colgate.com/en-us/oral-health/selecting-dental-products/what-is-a-toothpaste-color-code
• Mental Floss – What the color codes on toothpaste tubes really mean: https://www.mentalfloss.com/article/630094/what-the-color-codes-on-toothpaste-tubes-mean
• US patent – method and device for filling tubes (tubes are turned into position before sealing): https://image-ppubs.uspto.gov/dirsearch-public/print/downloadPdf/5471819
